## PluginTranscriptSelection

Public SDK type, exported as `PluginTranscriptSelection`. Import with `import type`; the SDK has no runtime exports.

One tutor-message text selection, captured when the action is clicked.

```ts
export interface PluginTranscriptSelection {
    readonly text: string;
    readonly messageId: string;
    readonly partIndex?: number;
}
```

**Member index** (including nested object members; inherited members are defined in the linked base types):

- [text](#plugintranscriptselection-text)
- [messageId](#plugintranscriptselection-messageid)
- [partIndex](#plugintranscriptselection-partindex)

### PluginTranscriptSelection text

Selected rendered text, at most PLUGIN_SELECTION_TEXT_LIMIT UTF-8 bytes.

```ts
readonly text: string;
```

### PluginTranscriptSelection messageId

Native id of the persisted tutor message containing the selection.

```ts
readonly messageId: string;
```

### PluginTranscriptSelection partIndex

Content part index within that message, when the host can resolve it.

```ts
readonly partIndex?: number;
```

## PluginTranscriptSelectionActionContext

Public SDK type, exported as `PluginTranscriptSelectionActionContext`. Import with `import type`; the SDK has no runtime exports.

Invoked from the host selection popover over a session transcript. The
surface is "transcript", not "session": it carries no whole-session `view`.

```ts
export interface PluginTranscriptSelectionActionContext {
    placement: "transcript-selection";
    surface: "transcript";
    sessionId: string;
    kind: "teaching" | "practice";
    selection: PluginTranscriptSelection;
}
```

**Related types:** [PluginTranscriptSelection](plugin-action-contexts.md#plugintranscriptselection).

## PluginTranscriptSelectionPlacement

Public SDK type, exported as `PluginTranscriptSelectionPlacement`. Import with `import type`; the SDK has no runtime exports.

Place an action in the transcript selection popover of every session.

```ts
export interface PluginTranscriptSelectionPlacement {
    id: string;
    actionId: string;
    location: "transcript-selection";
}
```
